title: Angel Studios, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-13
summary: Angel Studios, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a secondary public offering of 14.3 million shares of its Class A common stock at $2.10 per share, expected to net approximately $28 million after underwriting fees and expenses, with closing anticipated on or about April 13, 2026.
key_points: Angel Studios (NYSE: ANGX) entered into an underwriting agreement with Roth Capital Partners to issue 14.3 million Class A common shares
Offering price: $2.10 per share; gross proceeds approximately $30 million
Net proceeds after discounts, commissions, and estimated expenses: approximately $28 million
Underwriters granted 30-day option to purchase up to an additional 2.145 million shares
Offering made pursuant to effective shelf registration statement on Form S-3 (File No. 333-291514)
Expected closing: on or about April 13, 2026
